recentItems.title: Greg Palast on U.S. Commerce Secretary Penny Pritzker
recentItems.description:
U.S. Secretary of Commerce Penny Pritzker has a sordid history of union busting, sub-prime lending, tax dodging, and more. She also played a major role in getting Barack Obama elected to the Presidency so, of course, Barack Obama had to pay her back by nominating and pushing her to be confirmed as U.S. Secretary of Commerce. (By the way, "progressive" Elizabeth Warren had no problem voting to confirm Pritzker's nomination.) 

This clip is an excerpt from "Greg Palast; Summers, Obama, Rubin-- The Bankster Monsters From Hell" which aired on the August 22, 2013 edition of the Rob Kall Bottom Up Radio Show.

Please do check out and listen to the complete, and very revealing, Greg Palast interview (available at http://www.opednews.com/itunes/229/greg-palast-summers22-aug_2013-20130822-321.mp3) in which Palast talks about a bombshell memo that shows how vile Larry Summers is. The interview covers what's in the memo and then expands to give background on the roots and top levels of one of the most malevolent conspiracies in the world.

recentItems.title: Lori Wallach explains: "Free Trade" is really an international corporate coup
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Jeremy Scahill on the permanent U S  National Security Apparatus
recentItems.description:
Jeremy Scahill's free lecture at the Lincoln Center Magnolia Theater in Ft. Collins, Colorado on April 9, 2014 featuring information about Scahill’s wartime investigations that yielded the book and film “Dirty Wars: The World is a Battlefield,” and the book, “Blackwater: The Rise of the World’s Most Powerful Mercenary Army.”

Just a few highlights:

http://youtu.be/0RDP4fp2JiI#t=0m48s Jeremy Scahill talks about his encounter with Blackwater mercenaries in the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina and how they'd been hired by Homeland Security in a megamillion dollar no bid contract to be the official protective force of FEMA.

http://youtu.be/0RDP4fp2JiI#t=5m30s Scahill talks about Blackwater's original mission, how it changed after 9/11, and about founder and owner Erik Prince's deep connections with radical, right-wing, evangelical Christians like James Dobson and Gary Bauer.

http://youtu.be/0RDP4fp2JiI#t=8m49s Scahill: "We are living in a moment where we have a Democratic President who won the Nobel Peace Prize, is a Constitutional lawyer by training, and is presiding over what is effectively a global assasination program." Scahill proceeds to explain how the Obama Administration has "expanded and continued the most egregious aspects of the Bush-Cheney so-called 'counterterrorism' apparatus."

http://youtu.be/0RDP4fp2JiI#t=14m39s Scahill: "President Obama ... has actually helped to realize the life's work of Donald Rumsfeld and Dick Cheney.

http://youtu.be/0RDP4fp2JiI#t=15m03s Scahill: "...in terms of damage to the cause of justice, in terms of damage to the reputation of the United States around the world, it would be hard to quantify just how much has been done under this [the Obama] Administration."

http://youtu.be/0RDP4fp2JiI#t=18m40s Scahill talks about the PERMANENT U.S. national security apparatus in the United States, how it operates, and how President Obama has basically given the national security "beast" everything it has wanted and more.

recentItems.title: Paul Craig Roberts on Russia, Ukraine, Monsanto, GMOs and more
recentItems.description:
Paul Craig Roberts On Russia De-dollarization, Psychopaths, Monsanto GMOs and more.

A bit of background on Paul Craig Roberts courtesy of The Greanville Post (http://greanvillepost.com):

"Roberts—this honest, almost downright radical man, is unclassifiable politically. How do you explain the transformation of a man who served as an Assistant Secretary of the Treasury in the Reagan Administration earning fame as a co-founder of Reaganomics to being something of an outspoken tribune of the people? His other creds are equally establishmentarian and right wing, which only adds to the mystery.  He is a former editor and columnist for the Wall Street Journal, Business Week, and Scripps Howard News Service. More in character, Roberts has been a critic of both Democratic and Republican administrations. And having been an insider, Roberts knows how the game is played. Paul Craig Roberts' trajectory either shows that just about anyone can find redemption from evil, or that miracles do happen..."

http://www.greanvillepost.com/2011/03/03/rob-kall-interviews-paul-craig-roberts-audio/

It's not necessary to completely agree with all of Roberts' views on economics (I don't) to recognize that what he is saying is critically important and needs to be understood by all. 

From the Rob Kall Bottom Up Radio Show broadcast of June 11, 2014 (http://www.opednews.com/Podcast/Paul-Craig-Roberts-On-Russ-by-Rob-Kall-Capitalism_Dollar_Domination_Glyphosate-140612-295.html)

recentItems.title: Vandana Shiva on GMO food, the lies and corruption behind it, and how it threatens our future
recentItems.description:
Vandana Shiva: "There has never been a threat to freedom as deep as what we face today through the control of the seed."

The April 3, 2014 edition of Tell Somebody features a conversation with world-renowned physicist, feminist, activist and author Vandana Shiva in which she discusses the lies we are told by Monsanto and others about GMOs. She explains how the push for genetically modified organisms is polluting our seeds, food, science and democracy and causing great harm. She also discusses what is being done to fight back.

Her many books include Water Wars, Soil Not Oil and Making Peace with the Earth.

recentItems.title: Richard Wolff interview of Stanley Aronowitz
recentItems.description:
